$$
∃\,\,{m}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{I}\end{aligned}}\in Z,\,{n}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{II}\end{aligned}}\,|\,{m}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{III}\end{aligned}}

Which occurrences of the variables in the expression above are free?

feedback.problem:
$$
(\,∃y\in (0,1),\,{x}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{I}\end{aligned}}y=1\,)⇒(\,∀{z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{II}\end{aligned}}\in (1,2),\,x{z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{III}\end{aligned}}>3\,)
$$

Which occurrences of the variables in the expression above are free?
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's examine our expression and mark the occurrences of the variables as bound $(\text{b})$ or free $(\text{f}).$

- Occurrence I of the variable $x$ is *free* since it isn't placed right next to a quantifier and it doesn't lie within the scope of a quantifier that uses $x.$

- Occurrence II of the variable $z$ is *bound* since it is placed right next to the quantifier $∀:$

$$
(\,∃y\in (0,1),\,xy=1\,)⇒(\,∀{z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\in (1,2),\,xz>3\,)
$$

- Occurrence III of the variable $z$ is *bound* since it lies within the scope of the quantifier $∀$ that uses $z:$

$$
(\,∃y\in (0,1),\,xy=1\,)⇒(\,∀z\in (1,2),\,\overset{\text{scope of }∀z}{\overset{⏞}{x{z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}>3}})
$$

 

The occurrences of variables in the expression are as follows:

$$
(\,∃{y}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\in (0,1),\,{x}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{f}\end{aligned}}{y}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}=1\,)⇒(\,∀{z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}\in (1,2),\,{x}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{f}\end{aligned}}{z}_{\begin{aligned} \\ ↑ \\ \text{b}\end{aligned}}>3\,)
$$

Therefore, the free occurrence is "I only."
